title: Punjab Local Government Third Amendment Act 1999

sections.shortTitle: Punjab Local Government Third Amendment Act 1999
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XI OF 1999
ACT XI OF 1999
PUNJAB LOCAL GOVERNMENT (THIRD AMENDMENT) ACT, 1999
1. Short title and commencement. ‑‑‑(I)
This Act may be called the Punjab Local Government (Third Amendment) Act, 1999.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

sections.shortTitle: Punjab Local Government Third Amendment Act 1999
sections.description:
Amendment of section 12 of Ordinance VI of 1979

ACT XI OF 1999
ACT XI OF 1999
PUNJAB LOCAL GOVERNMENT (THIRD AMENDMENT) ACT, 1999
2. Amendment of section 12 of Ordinance VI of 1979.‑‑In
the Punjab Local Government Ordinance, 1979 (VI of 1979), in section 12, in
subsection (1), in the second proviso, after the words "Vice‑Chairman
for", the words "a Metropolitan Corporation up to two irrespective of
the number of zones" shall be inserted.

3. Repeal.‑‑The Punjab Local Government
(Eleventh Amendment) Ordinance 1999 (XXXII of 1999) is hereby repealed.
